dsp GenMetalCowbellDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.35 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state q0 : F32 := 0.0
  state q1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1m : F32 := 0.0
  state i2m : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    set q0 := fract(q0 + 432.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q1 := fract(q1 + 640.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    let src := (select(lt(q0, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q1, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))) * 0.5
    let gm := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 800.0) / sr))
    let km := 0.4
    let am := 1.0 / (1.0 + gm * (gm + km))
    let v1m := am * (i1m + gm * (src - i2m))
    let v2m := i2m + gm * v1m
    set i1m := 2.0 * v1m - i1m
    set i2m := 2.0 * v2m - i2m
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1m * envA * 1.5) * 1.0) * 0.4245

dsp GenMetalCowbellBright where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.35 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state q0 : F32 := 0.0
  state q1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1m : F32 := 0.0
  state i2m : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    set q0 := fract(q0 + 648.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q1 := fract(q1 + 960.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    let src := (select(lt(q0, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q1, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))) * 0.5
    let gm := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 800.0) / sr))
    let km := 0.4
    let am := 1.0 / (1.0 + gm * (gm + km))
    let v1m := am * (i1m + gm * (src - i2m))
    let v2m := i2m + gm * v1m
    set i1m := 2.0 * v1m - i1m
    set i2m := 2.0 * v2m - i2m
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1m * envA * 1.5) * 1.0) * 0.3900

dsp GenHandCongaOpen where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state be : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let beA := select(trigger, gate, be * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set be := beA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.25, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + beA * 0.06)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.59 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 2.14 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.45 * (0.5 + colour) + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * 0.25) * envA + nz * ceA) * 0.7) * 0.6043

dsp GenHandTablaOpen where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state be : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let beA := select(trigger, gate, be * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set be := beA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.25, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + beA * 0.25)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.59 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 2.14 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.45 * (0.5 + colour) + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * 0.25) * envA + nz * ceA) * 0.7) * 0.6419

handTalkingDrumOpen.source:
dsp GenHandTalkingDrumOpen where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state be : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state p3 : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let beA := select(trigger, gate, be * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set be := beA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.25, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.004 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + beA * 0.4)
    set p1 := fract(p1 + min(0.45, f / sr))
    set p2 := fract(p2 + min(0.45, f * 1.59 / sr))
    set p3 := fract(p3 + min(0.45, f * 2.14 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.45 * (0.5 + colour) + sinpi(p3 * 2.0) * 0.25) * envA + nz * ceA) * 0.7) * 0.6581

dsp GenHitClapDry where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.12 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state tick : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1h : F32 := 0.0
  state i2h : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let tickA := select(trigger, 0.0, tick + 1.0 / sr)
    set tick := tickA
    let pulses := select(lt(fract(tickA * 90.0), 0.35), 1.0, 0.4) * select(lt(tickA, 0.035), 1.0, 0.6)
    let gh := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (1200.0 * (0.7 + colour * 0.6))) / sr))
    let kh := 0.6
    let ah := 1.0 / (1.0 + gh * (gh + kh))
    let v1h := ah * (i1h + gh * (nz - i2h))
    let v2h := i2h + gh * v1h
    set i1h := 2.0 * v1h - i1h
    set i2h := 2.0 * v2h - i2h
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1h * envA * pulses) * 1.6) * 0.9022

dsp GenHitClickDry where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.12 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state tick : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1h : F32 := 0.0
  state i2h : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let tickA := select(trigger, 0.0, tick + 1.0 / sr)
    set tick := tickA
    let pulses := 1.0
    let gh := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (4000.0 * (0.7 + colour * 0.6))) / sr))
    let kh := 0.6
    let ah := 1.0 / (1.0 + gh * (gh + kh))
    let v1h := ah * (i1h + gh * (nz - i2h))
    let v2h := i2h + gh * v1h
    set i1h := 2.0 * v1h - i1h
    set i2h := 2.0 * v2h - i2h
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1h * envA * pulses) * 1.6) * 0.3722

noiseWindStillNarrow.source:
dsp GenNoiseWindStillNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.0 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (600.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.4404

noiseWindSlowWide.source:
dsp GenNoiseWindSlowWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.13 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (600.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.8115

noiseWindGustyNarrow.source:
dsp GenNoiseWindGustyNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.6 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.25
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (600.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.4342

noiseSeaSlowNarrow.source:
dsp GenNoiseSeaSlowNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.13 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (400.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.3993

dsp GenNoiseRainStillNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.0 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (5000.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.3205

noiseRainStillWide.source:
dsp GenNoiseRainStillWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.0 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (5000.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.4978

noiseRainGustyNarrow.source:
dsp GenNoiseRainGustyNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.6 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.25
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (5000.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.2883

noiseSteamSlowNarrow.source:
dsp GenNoiseSteamSlowNarrow where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.13 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (7000.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 0.25
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 0.7 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.3641

dsp GenNoiseSteamSlowWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  state crack : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1w : F32 := 0.0
  state i2w : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.13 / sr)
    let move := 1.0 + sinpi(lfo * 2.0) * 0.45 + sinpi(lfo * 5.3) * 0.0
    let crackA := 0.0
    let gw := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (7000.0 * move * (0.6 + colour * 0.8))) / sr))
    let kw := 1.4
    let aw := 1.0 / (1.0 + gw * (gw + kw))
    let v1w := aw * (i1w + gw * (nz - i2w))
    let v2w := i2w + gw * v1w
    set i1w := 2.0 * v1w - i1w
    set i2w := 2.0 * v2w - i2w
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((v1w * 1.0 + crackA * nz * 0.6) * envA * move) * 1.2) * 0.4859
